title: 第3章 江湖之事，观内奸细
slug: 刚成仙神子孙求我出山
content_zh:
“陈施主若是有心，可直接赠予龙起观，为何要单独赠予我？”
姜长生问道，眼睛盯着陈礼。
陈礼一愣，虽已经体会过此子异于常人的成熟，但还是被惊到，他摇头失笑道：“龙起观何等地位，岂是我能单独结交的，于礼不合，于情更不实，我只是想与小道长结交，小道长年少便有如此武功，他日必定是武林翘楚，甚至能成为武状元，为朝堂效力。”
他是去年考取的状元，因身世引民间议论，但书籍乃传承之重本，大多掌握在士族手里，平民哪能考得过士族，今年皇帝特意推行双状元，文武各一位。
习武在这个世界的成本不高，天下多的是收人的门派，只是习武需要天资，可读书同样需要，相较而言，平民在武道上更容易出头。
龙起观乃皇帝亲命的道观，陈家可不敢直接与清虚道长结交，容易惹来圣上的猜忌。
姜长生觉得他的话在理，人生在世，光是一味的躲避，并不能安稳一辈子，反而结交一些权贵也是有好处的。
更重要的是，姜长生虽认命，但他娘的不服啊，假太子必须想办法搞死，其背后的权贵也不能放过。
他回顾十二年前的记忆，所听闻的权贵之中，确实没有陈姓。
姜长生点头道：“那我就收下了，我一小道士也不能薄了你状元郎的面子。”
陈礼露出笑容，没有感到嘲讽，只要对方收下，那就是好的开始。
他之所以这么热情，也是受家族影响，陈家太需要强大武者，他们拉拢过不少武夫，但个个为利益所摇动，姜长生不同，还年幼，只要好好给予资源，迟早心向陈家。
陈礼开始说起凶案，原来薛海是想行刺他，但他一直与清虚道长待在一起，求取道法，薛海又被死者撞见鬼鬼祟祟，出于官大于商的心态，对薛海一阵逼问，薛海心烦，便将其杀了，至于姜长生，完全是被嫁祸的，原来薛海在夜里曾远远的瞧见姜长生在练腿法。
姜长生回忆了一下，确实有过被窥探的感觉，但稍纵即逝，自己也没有真正瞧见对方，便没有放在心上。
“我也是涉世太浅，被薛海三言两语带偏了方向，还自以为聪明，看破了真相。”陈礼叹气道，神色颇为羞愧。
姜长生见他能认错，对其印象改观，跟着好奇问道：“薛海为何要杀你？”
陈礼瞥了青苦一眼，青苦愣了愣，然后懂事的退出去，将房门关上。
“此事涉及前朝，我陈家原是前朝的官吏，只是后来迷途知返，薛海便是前朝余孽，杀我，只是想嫁祸给当朝，让那些投诚的士族意识到朝廷对前朝投靠过来的家族并不友好，可惜，他失败了。”陈礼无奈道。
陈家真的很憋屈，在当朝别扭，还得面对前朝的报复。
姜长生没有同情，谁让你是第一位状元郎，枪打出头鸟。

站在薛海的立场也能理解，叛徒比仇人可恨多了。
陈礼没有过多说朝堂上的纠纷，知晓姜长生还未曾下山过，他说起武林里的趣事。
武林泰斗独战八大门派，威震武林。
神僧伏妖受伤，惨遭黑客栈小二毒杀。
玄音楼圣女被盗圣潜入闺房，盗走财物。
鬼目邪王被朝廷抓拿，打入天牢。
诸如此类，听得姜长生津津有味。
陈礼也向他普及了武夫的等级，由低到高分别为三流、二流、一流以及真元境，能让体内真气以武学方式攻击敌人，那便算踏入真元境，薛海便是真元境高手，习武近二十载。
姜长生对比了一下，他觉得自己击杀薛海并不难，得益于道法自然功，仅练成第二层，他体内真气便足够他挥霍神影腿、九寻天龙步。
还是修仙强啊。
足足过去半个时辰，陈礼方才离去。
姜长生望着桌上的秘籍，陷入思索中。
这秘籍上会不会有毒？
春去秋来，自陈礼离去后，时间过去数月，龙起观上的树叶渐渐变黄，姜长生的日子恢复以往，弟子们也不再对他好奇，同舍的师弟青苦也很少打扰他，只因青苦也沉醉于武学之中，无法自拔。
要说变化，最大的变化就是姜长生白日也能光明正大的练功，他的真气一直在增长，初步掌握金刚啸，至于气指，还未修炼。
他想先完全掌握金刚啸，再练气指。
陈礼没有再来过，凶案之后，清虚道长也没有单独见过姜长生。
这一日。
姜长生终于达到道法自然功第三层，感官大幅度提升，他甚至能听见百丈开外的蚊虫声音，连其他弟子的呼吸声都能听得清清楚楚，这种感觉无比奇妙。
自身的真气倒是没有提升，但他明显感受到真气在微微变化，或许是朝着灵力转变的趋势。

数个时辰后，他来到庭院内，弟子们还未回庭院，仍在道殿听道，他开始修行金刚啸。
修炼金刚啸，不需要放开嗓子吼，只需要打通喉咙隐藏的经脉即可，当真气共振时，他能判断出吼出来的威力，以往那隐形经脉很难被激活，功法突破后，他发现真气灌入隐形经脉的过程变得流畅，也没有了以往的痛楚。
姜长生很高兴，果然，功法才是基础，以后大部分时间仍得花在功法上。
傍晚，青苦回到屋内。
“师兄，二师兄打算带着十五名弟子下山历练，特意让我来问你，你愿意前往吗？”青苦兴奋的询问。
他们这些弟子几乎都是孤儿，每一次历练都会带回来一批新弟子。
上山后，青苦还未下山过，对山下的一切都好奇，听来的宾客说过，如今盛世即将到来，人间已看不到战乱。
姜长生摇头道：“我就不去了。”
青苦又劝了几句，但他就是不去，青苦只能作罢。
不可能！
除非自身武力已经天下无敌，否则姜长生不可能下山，龙起观就在京城内，那些窥探他的权贵必然还盯着。
毕竟他的身份要是暴露，那可是要被砍脑袋，真龙大怒，多大的官都得下马。
这些年里，皇帝肃清派系，开朝功臣不知死了多少。
第二日早晨，二师兄孟秋河便带着一批弟子下山，其中包括青苦，姜长生没有去送别，而是在道钟楼前面朝骄阳练功。
一直到夜晚，姜长生正欲起身。
【开元十二年，奸细劝说二师兄，想引你下山，你拒绝了，从而躲过一场杀祸，获得生存奖励——杂术‘炼丹术’】
看到这行提示，姜长生愣住，差点喷出一句脏话。
龙起观内有奸细？
首先排除二师兄孟秋河，在他两岁时差点被习武的大师兄误杀，是孟秋河救的他，而且这一次孟秋河是被劝说的。
莫非是大师兄？

两岁那年那一次并非失误，而是有意为之？
姜长生开始思索里平日里谁看自己的眼神不对劲，谁有可能，甚至连青苦都被他怀疑。
想了很久，他也想不明白。
不过可以确信，下山就有危险，而在道观内，只要清虚道长还在，奸人不敢肆意妄为。
姜长生目前要做的就是努力成长，隐藏实力。
上次凶案，他只是展示了习武天分便引来奸细行动，关于神影腿、金刚啸以及道法自然功决不能展现出来。
好在他平日里很少炫耀。
姜长生起身，朝着自己的庭院走去，沿途弟子们向他打招呼，他都笑着回应，然后默默在判断。
他都拒绝下山了，那奸细应该还在山上。
这些人都有可能！
龙起观内的秋叶被白雪覆盖，经过日月近百次轮回，白雪融化，新春到来。
开元十三年，姜长生十三岁。
这一年，皇帝得了失心疯，开始追求仙术，广招天下能人异士为他炼丹。
“这世上哪有仙人，那些邪祟也不过是精怪所化，陛下为了仙术，连朝政都不理了，不过好在太子殿下天生聪慧，熟读四书五经，已经开始帮忙处理部分政事。”
陈礼感慨道，言语中对太子充满赞赏。
姜长生面不改色，心里则有些不爽。
十三岁就可以掌权，这小兔崽子有点能耐啊。
姜长生好奇问道：“太子殿下如此优秀吗，能跟我说说他的事吗？”
陈礼笑道：“自然可以，说来太子殿下也算命运多舛，出世前被陛下定为太子，未出世即为太子，纵观历史，也独此一份，然而皇后娘娘生下太子后便大病，昏迷数月才醒，醒后就迷失了心智，说太子殿下不是她的儿子，没有母亲的关爱，又有其他皇子诞生，太子殿下在皇宫里可谓是尝遍人情冷暖，连陛下都曾冷待过他，好在他天资聪慧，三岁识千字，五岁可触景编诗，又获得了陛下的宠爱。”
听到这话，姜长生不由想起这一世的母亲，在娘胎里，他便经常听闻母亲自言自语，说以后要对自己怎样怎样好，吐槽皇帝行事如何鲁莽等。

他心里有些酸楚。
原来这世上除了恶人，还有人念叨着他。
姜长生好奇问道：“皇后娘娘现在如何，她都……依旧是皇后？”
陈礼瞪了他一眼，道：“那是自然，陛下与皇后娘娘何等的恩爱，天见可怜，如今皇后娘娘已经恢复健康，与太子殿下的关系也已经修复，国泰民安，盛世降临，这里面可是有皇后娘娘的一份功劳。”
姜长生无言以对，心里也稍微宽慰。
不管怎样，她至少活得挺好。
content_en:
"If Donor Chen is serious about it, he can directly give it to Long Qiguan. Why do you want to give it to me alone?"
Jiang Changsheng asked, staring at Chen Li.
Chen Li was stunned. Although he had experienced the maturity of this boy that was different from ordinary people, he was still shocked. He shook his head and said with a smile: "Long Qiguan is of such a high status that I can't befriend him alone. It's not suitable for etiquette, and it's not true for love. I just want to make friends with the little Taoist. He has such martial arts at a young age. He will definitely be a leader in martial arts in the future, and even become a martial arts champion and serve the court."
He was the number one scholar in the examination last year, and his life experience aroused public discussion. However, books are the important books of inheritance, and most of them are in the hands of the nobles. How can ordinary people pass the examination of the nobles? This year, the emperor specially promoted the dual number one scholar, one for civil and military affairs.
The cost of practicing martial arts in this world is not high. There are many sects in the world that accept people. However, practicing martial arts requires talent, as does studying. In comparison, it is easier for civilians to excel in martial arts.
Longqi Temple is a Taoist temple appointed by the emperor himself. The Chen family does not dare to associate directly with Taoist Master Qingxu, as it may easily arouse the suspicion of the Holy Emperor.
Jiang Changsheng felt that what he said was reasonable. In life, just avoiding people blindly would not lead to a stable life. On the contrary, it would be beneficial to make friends with some powerful people.
More importantly, although Jiang Changsheng accepted his fate, he refused to accept it. The fake prince must be killed by some means, and the powerful people behind him must not let go.
He looked back at his memories from twelve years ago and found that among the powerful people he had heard of, there was indeed no one with the surname Chen.
Jiang Changsheng nodded and said, "Then I'll accept it. I, a little Taoist priest, can't let you lose face."
Chen Li smiled and did not feel ridiculed. As long as the other party accepted it, that would be a good start.
The reason why he is so enthusiastic is also due to the influence of his family. The Chen family needs strong warriors. They have attracted many warriors, but all of them are swayed by their own interests. Jiang Changsheng is different. He is still young. As long as he is given good resources, he will sooner or later turn to the Chen family.
Chen Li began to talk about the murder. It turned out that Xue Hai wanted to assassinate him, but he had been staying with Taoist Master Qingxu to seek Taoism. Xue Hai was caught by the deceased sneaking around. Out of the mentality of being an official over a businessman, he questioned Xue Hai for a while.
Jiang Changsheng recalled that he did have the feeling of being spied on, but it was fleeting and he didn't really see the other person, so he didn't take it to heart.
"I am also too inexperienced in the world. I was led astray by Xue Hai's few words. I thought I was smart and saw through the truth." Chen Li sighed, looking quite ashamed.
Seeing that he could admit his mistake, Jiang Changsheng changed his impression and asked curiously: "Why did Xue Hai want to kill you?"
Chen Li glanced at Qing Ku, who was stunned for a moment, then exited sensibly and closed the door.
"This matter involves the previous dynasty. My Chen family was originally an official of the previous dynasty, but I later found out that I had returned. Xue Hai was a remnant of the previous dynasty. He wanted to kill me just to put the blame on the current dynasty and make the surrendered nobles realize that the imperial court was not friendly to the families who had defected to the previous dynasty. Unfortunately, he failed." Chen Li said helplessly.
The Chen family is really aggrieved. They are awkward in the current dynasty and have to face the revenge of the previous dynasty.
Jiang Changsheng has no sympathy. Who made you the number one champion?
From Xue Hai's point of view, we can understand that traitors are much more hateful than enemies.
Chen Li did not talk too much about the disputes in the court. Knowing that Jiang Changsheng had not yet gone down the mountain, he talked about interesting things in the martial arts world.
The martial arts master fights against the eight major sects alone and is powerful in the martial arts world.
The divine monk Fu Yao was injured and was poisoned by the hacker's waiter.
The saint of Xuanyin Tower was stolen into the boudoir and stole the property.
The evil king Guimu Xie was captured by the court and thrown into a prison.
Jiang Changsheng was very excited when he heard this.
Chen Li also popularized the levels of martial arts to him. From low to high, they are third-rate, second-rate, first-rate, and true essence realm, which can allow the true energy in the body to attack in a martial way.Enemies, that means they have entered the True Yuan Realm. Xue Hai is a master of the True Yuan Realm and has been practicing martial arts for nearly twenty years.
Jiang Changsheng made a comparison and felt that it was not difficult for him to kill Xue Hai. Thanks to the Taoist natural skills, he had only practiced the second level, and the true energy in his body was enough for him to spend the Divine Shadow Legs and the Nine-Xun Tianlong Steps.
He is still stronger at cultivating immortals.
Half an hour passed before Chen Li left.
Jiang Changsheng looked at the secret book on the table and fell into thinking.
Will this secret book be poisonous?
Spring has passed and autumn has come. A few months have passed since Chen Li left. The leaves on Longqi Temple gradually turn yellow. Jiang Changsheng's life has returned to the past. His disciples are no longer curious about him. Qing Ku, his junior fellow student, rarely disturbs him, because Qing Ku is also addicted to martial arts and cannot extricate himself.
In terms of changes, the biggest change is that Jiang Changsheng can practice Qigong openly during the day. His Qi has been growing and he has initially mastered the Vajra Roar. As for Qi Finger, he has not yet practiced it.
He wanted to fully master the Vajra Roar first, and then practice the Qi Finger.
Chen Li never came again, and after the murder, Taoist Master Qingxu never saw Jiang Changsheng alone.
This day.
Jiang Changsheng finally reached the third level of Taoist Natural Skill, and his senses were greatly improved. He could even hear the sound of mosquitoes a hundred feet away, and could even hear the breathing of other disciples clearly. This feeling was extremely wonderful.
His own true energy has not improved, but he clearly feels that his true energy is changing slightly, perhaps a trend towards spiritual power.
A few hours later, he came to the courtyard. The disciples had not returned to the courtyard yet and were still listening to the sermon in the Taoist hall. He began to practice the Vajra Roar.
To practice the Vajra Roar, you don't need to let go of your throat and roar, you only need to open the hidden meridians in the throat. When the true energy resonates, he can judge the power of the roar. In the past, the invisible meridians were difficult to activate. After the breakthrough of the technique, he found that the process of infusing the true energy into the invisible meridians became smoother, and there was no pain as before.
Jiang Changsheng was very happy. As expected, the exercises were the foundation, and he would still have to spend most of his time on them in the future.
In the evening, Qing Ku returned to the house.
"Senior brother, the second senior brother plans to take fifteen disciples down the mountain for training, and asked me to ask you, are you willing to go?" Qing Ku asked excitedly.
These disciples are almost all orphans, and every experience brings back a group of new disciples.
After going up the mountain, Qing Ku has not yet come down, and is curious about everything down the mountain. The guests he heard said that now the prosperous age is coming, and wars will no longer be seen in the world.
Jiang Changsheng shook his head and said, "I won't go."
Qing Ku tried to persuade him a few more times, but he refused to go, so Qing Ku had no choice but to give up.
impossible!
Unless his own force is invincible, it is impossible for Jiang Changsheng to go down the mountain. Long Qiguan is in the capital, and the dignitaries who are spying on him must still be watching.
After all, if his identity is exposed, his head will be chopped off. The real dragon will be furious, and all officials will be dismounted.
In these years, the emperor purged the factions, and countless heroes who founded the dynasty died.
The next morning, second senior brother Meng Qiuhe came down the mountain with a group of disciples, including Qing Ku. Jiang Changsheng did not go to say goodbye, but practiced in front of the Dao Bell Tower facing the scorching sun.
Until night, Jiang Changsheng was about to get up.
[In the twelfth year of Kaiyuan, a spy persuaded the second senior brother to lure you down the mountain, but you refused, thus escaping a murder and receiving a survival reward—the miscellaneous art of alchemy]
Seeing this line of prompts, Jiang Changsheng was stunned and almost uttered a curse word.
Is there a spy in Longqi Temple?
First of all, we exclude the second senior brother Meng Qiuhe. When he was two years old, he was almost accidentally killed by his senior martial arts brother. It was Meng Qiuhe who saved him, and this time Meng Qiuhe was persuaded.
Could it be the senior brother?
That time when you were two years old was not a mistake, but intentional?
Jiang Changsheng began to think about who looked at him in the usual way, who might have looked at him wrong, and even Qing Ku was suspected by him.
After thinking for a long time, he couldn't figure it out.
But you can be sure that going down the mountain is dangerous.In the Taoist temple, as long as Taoist Master Qingxu is still there, traitors will not dare to act recklessly.
What Jiang Changsheng has to do now is to work hard to grow and hide his strength.
In the last murder case, he only showed his talent in martial arts and it attracted spies to act. He must not show the divine shadow legs, diamond roar and Taoist natural skills.
Fortunately, he rarely shows off.
Jiang Changsheng stood up and walked towards his courtyard. The disciples greeted him along the way, and he responded with a smile, and then silently judged.
He refused to go down the mountain, so the spy should still be on the mountain.
It’s possible for these people!
The autumn leaves in Longqi Temple are covered with white snow. After nearly a hundred reincarnations of the sun and the moon, the snow melts and the new year arrives.
In the thirteenth year of Kaiyuan, Jiang Changsheng was thirteen years old.
This year, the emperor became insane and began to pursue immortality. He recruited talented people from all over the world to make elixirs for him.
"There are no immortals in this world. Those evil spirits are just transformed by spirits. For the sake of immortality, Your Majesty has even ignored the government affairs. Fortunately, His Highness the Crown Prince is naturally intelligent and is familiar with the Four Books and Five Classics. He has already begun to help handle some political affairs."
Chen Li sighed with emotion, his words full of admiration for the prince.
Jiang Changsheng's expression remained unchanged, but he felt a little unhappy in his heart.
Being able to take charge at the age of thirteen, this little brat is quite capable.
Jiang Changsheng asked curiously: "Is His Highness the Crown Prince so outstanding? Can you tell me about him?"
Chen Li said with a smile: "Of course, His Majesty the Crown Prince has a bad fate. He was designated as the Crown Prince before he was born, and he was crowned the Crown Prince before he was born. Throughout history, this is the only one. However, the Queen became seriously ill after giving birth to the Crown Prince. She was in a coma for several months before she woke up. After waking up, she lost her mind. It is said that the Queen was seriously ill after giving birth to the Crown Prince. His Royal Highness is not her son, he has no mother's care, and other princes have been born. His Royal Highness has experienced all kinds of kindness in the palace, and even His Majesty has treated him coldly. Fortunately, he is talented and intelligent. He can read a thousand words at the age of three, and he can compose poems based on the scenery at the age of five, and he has won His Majesty's favor. "
Hearing this, Jiang Changsheng couldn't help but think of his mother in this life. In his mother's womb, he often heard his mother talking to herself, saying how she would treat him well in the future, complaining about the emperor's reckless behavior, etc.
He felt a little sad.
It turns out that in addition to evil people in this world, there are still people who are talking about him.
Jiang Changsheng asked curiously: "How is the Queen now? Is she... still the Queen?"
Chen Li glared at him and said: "That's natural. The love between Your Majesty and the Queen is so pitiful. Now that the Queen has recovered her health, the relationship with His Highness the Crown Prince has also been repaired. The country is peaceful and the people are in peace, and a prosperous age has come. The Queen has contributed a lot to this."
Jiang Changsheng was speechless and felt a little relieved.
No matter what, at least she's living well.
